rules.hint: the profile has no access to the ad account, or the account is not active: check the Accounts page
rules.label: Ad account is active

rules.hint: choose a Facebook Page in this campaign or use Automatic; Refresh pages to retry loading
rules.label: Facebook Page

rules.hint: the ad is set for Instagram placements: connect an Instagram account to the Facebook Page, or wait for manual placements (ACL-1772) to publish Facebook-only
rules.label: Instagram account of the Page

rules.hint: website conversions need exactly one pixel on the ad account; set pixel_id on the Accounts page
rules.label: Pixel for conversions

rules.hint: pick an ACTIVE form of this Page (Refresh forms)
rules.label: Instant Form of the Page

rules.hint: choose one of the Page's forms or a template in the ad
rules.label: Instant Form chosen

rules.hint: the template needs a privacy policy URL that starts with https://
rules.label: Form template: privacy policy URL (https)

rules.hint: the template needs at least one contact field (name, email or phone)
rules.label: Form template: a contact field

rules.hint: accept the Lead Ads terms for this Page in Meta (the robot never accepts them), then check again
rules.label: Lead Ads terms accepted on the Page

rules.hint: pick the country in the account
rules.label: Country

rules.hint: Meta found no exact match for the country: check its name or ISO code
rules.label: Country found in Meta targeting

rules.hint: Meta found no exact match for the language: pick it from the list or clear the field
rules.label: Language found in Meta targeting

rules.hint: Meta found no exact match for some terms: pick one of the candidates or fix the term in the library
rules.label: Detailed targeting found in Meta

rules.hint: Meta has only a near match for some terms: Confirm the pick in Check plan (it is remembered)
rules.label: Detailed targeting picks confirmed

rules.hint: enter the website URL, starting with https://
rules.label: Link https://

rules.hint: the link has no ?key=value parameters: clicks may not be attributed
rules.label: Tracking parameters in the link

rules.hint: choose a file in each ad
rules.label: Media chosen

rules.hint: the file is missing, empty or unreadable: choose another file
rules.label: Media file exists and is readable

rules.hint: file type, size (image 30 MB, video 1536 MB) or video length is over the limit
rules.label: Media within Meta limits

rules.hint: no 9:16 file: without one Facebook crops the picture itself
rules.label: Vertical file for Stories and Reels

rules.hint: choose the main (1:1 or 4:5) file too, or clear the Stories / Reels file
rules.label: Main file next to the Stories / Reels file

rules.hint: with a Stories / Reels file the main file must be 1:1 or 4:5, the vertical one 9:16, both images or both videos, and the size must be readable (JPG/PNG, MP4/MOV)
rules.label: Aspect ratios: main 1:1 or 4:5, Stories / Reels 9:16

rules.hint: an ad takes up to 5 primary texts, 5 headlines and 5 descriptions: remove the extra ones
rules.label: Up to 5 texts per field

rules.hint: Several primary texts and a Stories/Reels file can't be combined: Meta applies one text per placement group. Use several texts without the vertical file, or one text with it.
rules.label: Several texts and a Stories / Reels file

rules.hint: Several texts need Dynamic Creative, which isn't supported yet: use one text per ad (or one text with the Stories / Reels file)
rules.label: Several texts per ad

rules.hint: choose a primary text in each ad
rules.label: Primary text

rules.hint: the chosen text has no headline: pick another library entry
rules.label: Headline

rules.hint: a longer headline may be cut off
rules.label: Headline up to 40 characters

rules.hint: after 125 characters the text is folded behind 'See more'
rules.label: Text visible in full (up to 125)

rules.hint: choose a call to action that the objective accepts
rules.label: CTA allowed for the objective

rules.hint: enter a daily budget above zero
rules.label: Daily budget

rules.hint: raise the daily budget to Meta's minimum for the account currency
rules.label: Budget is at least Meta's minimum

rules.hint: age must be between 18 and 65, and min not above max
rules.label: Age 18-65

rules.hint: iOS and Android are mobile only (not desktop only), and a minimum version needs iOS or Android and looks like 14 or 14.0
rules.label: Devices and OS version fit together

rules.hint: enter the start as date and time, not earlier than today (ad account time zone)
rules.label: Start time

rules.hint: give the ads different creatives or texts: their names must differ inside a campaign
rules.label: Ad names are unique

rules.hint: give every ad set of the campaign its own name
rules.label: Ad set names are unique

rules.hint: add an ad to the ad set or remove the ad set
rules.label: Every ad set has an ad

rules.hint: if a different campaign already has this name, the robot publishes as NAME_2, NAME_3 ... (up to _20); an error only when all 20 names are taken: rename the campaign
rules.label: Campaign name is free, or gets a _2, _3 suffix
